messages:
jordan: quick sync — what I did: ran the quarterly key-access audit, exported findings to the ticket (csv attached). 92% of grants follow least-privilege patterns. Blockers: found two service accounts with broad kms:Decrypt grants, need owner confirmation before I narrow perms. Today: opening PR to tighten those grants and adding automated checks.
lee: thanks — which service accounts? can you paste the ARNs here so I can cross-check with IAM inventory?
jordan: svc/redwood-dataflow@infra and svc/log-ingest@infra. opened issue #4127 with details and current grant JSON.
priya: did we get the vuln scan results from last night? I noticed a new finding for log-processor image (CVE-2025-4281). Is that being tracked?
sam: yep, I pulled the report this morning. I started a patch branch to bump the base image and rebuild. PR will include the CVE fix and updated SBOM but I need infra approval for canary rollout.
mika: heads up — engbot kicked off a staging deploy at 10:12 and the canary showed KMS decrypt failures for a subset of requests. error logs point to missing grant for the ingestion role.
jordan: blocker confirmed: earlier grant cleanup removed a legacy grant used by the ingestion pipeline. I'm rolling the key alias back to alias/ingest-key-legacy to restore traffic while we fix grants.
lee: quick ops check command that helped me debug: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/ingest-key | jq '.Grants[] | {GranteePrincipal,Operations}'` — I found an unexpected grant to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/legacy-ingest-role. I'll propose a deny-based rule to exclude STS-assumed principals.
priya: small compliance note — when you update the grants, please add the before/after snapshots to /compliance/evidence/kms-grants/ so auditors have a trace. I updated the rotation evidence doc with last rotation dates.
sam: putting the PR up now: https://git.company/repo/pull/1287 — includes CVE patch, image bump, and canary delta config. @lee @mika please review for infra/canary concerns.
mika: will review and run a smoke in staging, ETA 4pm PT. I'm also going to ping oncall-bot to confirm the rotation window doesn't overlap with our canary traffic.
oncall-bot: Reminder: KMS rotation dry-run scheduled 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC. If you have active canaries, consider adding `--no-overlap` or shifting the window.
priya: FYI — I've scheduled a short compliance sync on Friday 09:30 PT to sign off on the rotation plan and evidence. Please add any open items to the agenda. :calendar:
jordan: thanks all — main blockers identified, rolling back alias to keep service healthy and opening PR to fix grants. Will update issue #4127 with grant diffs once PR merges. :thumbsup:
